description: Found in defk-hki. The range-fact machinery (in_bounds?/3, add_facts/sub_facts) has no facts from a guarding condition: in rolling mean_std, old = if i >= w, do: x[i - w], else: 0.0 keeps a bounds check that i >= w half-proves (0 <= i - w); the other half needs w >= 0, which needs a fact from an earlier guard or the caller. defk-hki got mean_std within 10% another way (flagged strips, seen_later/1), so this is for the bounds checks themselves: they would drop in both the flagged and the unflagged form. Scope: comparisons of an i64 local or loop counter with another i64 value in an if/cond condition narrow lo/hi or lb/ub in the taken branch. Done when x[i - w] under if i >= w and w >= 1 established by an earlier guard (e.g. a raise when w < 1) drops its bounds check, with a test, and the fast-path report's 'nothing proves' text names the missing fact correctly.
